too powerful and should be removed. The party ignored him. By the end of the 1920s, Stalin
had outplayed every rival. The biggest, Leon Trotsky, was thrown out of the country, hunted
down in Mexico, and killed with an ice axe. Stalin wanted to turn a country of peasants
into an industrial superpower in about 10 years. So he forced farmers off their own land
and onto giant state farms. Those who resisted were shot or sent to labor camps. But gulag.
Grain was taken away even as people starved. In 1932 and 1933, millions died in a famine.
Ukraine suffered the most. Ukrainians call it the Holodomor. Death by hunger.
Then Stalin turned on everyone else. In 1937 and 1938, his secret police arrested around

In 1945, Soviet soldiers raised the red flag over Berlin. The cost is almost impossible to imagine.
Around 27 million Soviet people died. Almost every family lost someone.
